scientific limitations/integrity: Exact finite claim for the labeled 13-vertex Köhler--Lutz triangulation only. The proof reconstructs the complex from the published orbit data and exhausts all relevant tetrahedral links and positive-index bistellar centers. No claim of global vertex-minimality, uniqueness, or impossibility of bistellar paths after adding vertices is made. The earlier census article is object-level prior art but was not available as searchable full text for a complete statement comparison; its possible unindexed finite observations remain a residual originality risk.
title: Short-link projective-plane geometry and bistellar rigidity in the 13-vertex Wu manifold
